lines.en: My legs feel weak, but I manage to steady them long enough to pick myself up off the ground.
Molly is completely unconscious and, until a second ago...I think I may have been too?
I can’t really say.
No.
There’s no way I was unconscious.
I did this.
But when?
How?
And what am I supposed to do now?
Just leave her here, passed out and covered in semen?
At least when I left Makoto in here last year, she was still capable of rational thought.
Well...mostly.
I don’t even know if Molly is alive at this point or not.
Right. I should check to see if she’s alive.
I should check to see if she is still breathing.
I should do something.
Anything.
I can’t just leave her here.
I did this.
Why did I do this?
MOLLY LEAVES THE ROOM
No. Molly doesn’t leave the room. Molly is here.
Molly is drunk.
I need to help Molly.
I need to get someone.
I need to-
She probably just jerked me off or something.
She was-
That’s right. She was having a sex dream.
She started touching herself and I...must have started doing the same.
But I remember her hand. I remember-
The glove. Her glove was on.
It's still on.
I can see it.
I’ll check her-
I have to leave this room before someone finds out.
No. I have to clean her up first.
I have to clean her up first or someone will find out what I did.
Molly is drunk.
Molly is unconscious.
I won’t be able to rationalize this.
Does she know?
Will she remember?
Will I remember?
What is this?
I stare down at Molly’s body, limp and coated in the remnants of something horrible, and realize that...
That I should be realizing more.
That there should be a flood of feelings washing over me or at least...regret? Regret would work best here, wouldn’t it?
But instead of that, or instead of anything at all, I’m just staring at her.
I’m wondering how I finished. If I did it to myself or if she played a part in it.
If she knew I was here at all or if this was all one big dream.
What time is it? Is the party over?
Did we get lost in the hall of many halls?
Did she want this?
Did I want this?
And if I did, why don’t I remember wanting it?
Why don’t I want more now?
What am I supposed to do?
Someone is here.
Someone is going to see what I’ve done.
I don’t even know what I’ve done.
They can’t get mad at me for what I’ve done if they don’t know what I’ve done.
I can explain this.
I blacked out.
Or...
Molly wanted it.
She was drunk and sad. She wanted it.
I didn’t do this.
I don’t touch girls that don’t want me to touch them.
That’s my rule. That and tears. I won’t touch girls who are crying.
I didn’t do this.
I did this.
What have I done?
: Hello, nyaa.
: I have come to check on the safety of the Emerald Guardian, for I have heard from the Green Onion that she was not feeling well.
: Is there a reason you are just standing-
: ...there?
: What...happened?
: I don’t know ...
: What is that...fluid on her?...
: I don’t know ...
: Did...
: Did...you?...
: I don’t know ...
: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?!
: Remaining silent is not an option! This is not a game!
: What have you done to the Guardian?!
: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO MOLLY?!
: So they were real swords after all.
: Are you so weak that you must prey upon the sleeping? That you must take advantage of those who can not so much as defend themselves?
: Explain what you have done or I will not allow you to leave this room alive.
: Gallows Edge.
: ...What?
: That’s what Molly called your sword during the last Halloween party.
: I just remembered that right now.
: What a peculiar thing for me to remember at a time like this.
: This is not a game! What have you done?!
: I remember sitting with the two of you on the stairs outside of the mansion.
: I said the exact opposite of what you just said, if I’m remembering correctly.
: What?...
: That life is a game.
: This is all just a game.
: Things were a little different back then.
: I think I liked that Halloween party a little more.
: Perhaps your nostalgia should wait until my friend is not unconscious, you fucking bastard.
: What have you done?
: You wouldn’t believe me if I said I don’t know, would you?
: Even now, with a blade against your throat, you refuse to take things seriously?
: You’re the queen of comedy, aren’t you? You should be able to figure out a joke when you hear one.
: What do you think that was, Tsuneyo?
: No gasp? I said your name. You’re supposed to gasp.
: Unfortunate.
: WHY HER?!
: She has done nothing but attempt to make my life better, and your response is to defile her?!
: She trusted you! You were sent here to help her!
: I don’t know what I did.
: I really don’t.
: Just ask her when she wakes up.
: You were supposed to be her friend!
: I don’t remember agreeing to be her friend.
: In front of the class!
: You told all of us you wanted to be our friends!
: That you were not a normal teacher!
: That you would help us!
: Yeah. I guess I did.
: But that was...
: Wait...
: Why do you know that?
: What?
: Is this another one of your jokes?
: No...I mean that you weren’t there when I said that.
: The only girls that should have heard that are the ones from the first floor.
: I am not as gullible as you think I am. I will not fall for your charades.
: How could I possibly remember something I was not there to hear?
: That’s...what I want to know.
: I will not allow you to confuse me at a time like this.
: If you are not going to explain what happened, leave this place at once.
: But if the Guardian awakens and tells me that you did anything unkind to her, I will flay the fat off of your body and use it to make soup broth.
: Do you understand that?
: DO YOU UNDERSTAND THAT?!
Tsuneyo slams the kashira of her sword against the wall with so much force that it shakes the room.
Of course, I planned on agreeing with her...I’m not just trying to find a way out of this anymore.
But...I’m having a hard time finding the words for anything right now.
I still don’t...understand what happened.
Or maybe I do and I just haven’t come to terms with it yet.
I don’t get it.
Why here? Why with Molly?
It’s like a repeat of the thing with Yumi way back, but...worse in every way.
And I know that. I understand that completely.
So why did it happen?
What have I done? Why did I do it?
What does this mean for the future?
: If you remain silent for a second longer, I will pin your hands to the wall of this room with my wakizashi.
: If you truly do not wish to explain yourself, will you put your trust in the Emerald Guardian- the same way she trusted you before you made a mockery of her?
: Or will you admit your wrongdoings now and face the consequences for your actions?
: Are the consequences death?
: If that is what I believe you deserve.
: Then I’ll trust Molly.
: I’m sorry, Tsuneyo.
: Do not apologize to me. I am not the one you wronged.
: Leave this place at once.
: Okay...
: Mngh...
: I am here, Guardian! Everything is okay now!
: Mnh...
: Kendo Princess?...What are you doing in here?...
: Is *hic*...the party over already?...
: You retired to this room to rest after consuming too much alcohol.
: But I am here to care for you now, regardless of whether or not you want me to.
: I will not leave your side until you ask me to.
: Nguh...I told ya not ta worry about me tonight...
: Go have fun with some’a the others. Me head’s killin’ me and I need to sleep.
: Then sleep and I shall watch over you.
: *Sniff sniff*
: Something...smells weird...
: Um...yes...
: I will attempt to find something to clean you off with.
: I was just ensuring that you were not hurt before doing that. But I will change my list of priorities now to make things easier for you.
: Ngh...whad’ya even need ta clean off’a me in the-
: I am unsure. But I know that it is nothing good.
: WHAT IN THE SEVEN HELLS IS THIS?!
: When I arrived...the Herald of the Adolescents was still in the room.
: I believe he may have done something to you while you were asleep.
: What?! Sensei was here?! When?!
: Up until the moment I arrived. I made him leave after seeing him loom over you in a menacing manner.
: Do you...remember anything happening at all?...
: Uh...n...no...not really...
: But if anything...really bad happened, I...think I’d be able to feel it...
: P...Probably?...
: And you feel nothing at all?
: I feel...dizzy...and...and my head hurts...
: And...and I'm confused, but...
: Um...weird question! He didn’t happen to...say anything, did he? About maybe...what happened, or?...
: He appeared to be having issues speaking as a whole. I sent him away as he was unable to explain himself or what had happened to you.
: And...his...clothes were on?
: Yes, Guardian.
: And...mine too? Like...you didn’t...dress me back up or anything?
: I did not. Your gear set was fully equipped when I arrived.
: Well then what the hell is all of this doing here?!
: I will fetch a towel immediately. Please do not move too quickly as we do not yet know what has happened to you.
: Ngh...
: Thanks...for your help, Tsuneyo...
: Can’t imagine how that would’a gone if any’a the others found me.
: I am simply doing what I believed any good friend would do.
: You seem less disturbed by what happened than I thought you would be, though.
: I suppose that maybe the Herald was not lying when he decided to trust you over accepting a swift and mostly painless death.
: Ya t’reatened ta kill ‘im? Ain’t t’at a bit much?
: If he had done something truly unforgivable, I don’t believe so.
: I’m...pretty sure it wasn’t anything like that...
: I can remember...talkin’ to him outside and then...comin’ in here...
: And my minds been all sorts’a screwed up lately. You know that.
: Maybe it was me?
: Kinda wish I’d remembered what happened if that were the case, though.
: 'Ve'eard 'bout blackout drinkin' before, but never knew'it'd 'appen'tis quickly.
: You still lasted much longer than I would.
: Yeah, well...you’re a special case.
: Do you really feel no pain at all, Emerald Guardian? Not even the slightest bit?
: Not from anything I didn’t do to myself, I don’t think.
: Just...not sure what to say to Sir now.
: You’re not mad about what he did to you?
: Well’ats exactly th’problem.
: I don’t wanna get mad too quickly if I played’a part in it.
: S’a different story if’e just wanked one off while I was sleeping...but I feel like it’s more’ten that.
: Or at least I hope it’s more.
: Beatin’ off on a sleepin’ girl’s a pretty shite quality in a person.
: You think he might have beaten you?
: No...Kendo Princess...
: I ‘tink it might’a been something sexual.
: I assumed that much, but I thought your heart was already possessed by the warlock Nithhala.
: Can multiple people hold dominion over the same organ at once?
: Yeah, but...I don’t know if I’d say that’s what’s goin’ on here.
: I don’t wanna bog ya down by talkin’ about it when I know’it makes ya flustered, but I’ve talked to Sir about stuff like that recently.
: And since I’ve already been playin’ around with the idea of maybe divin’ in’ta that sorta’ting...I just think this might be...my fault.
: I will respect your outlook. But I do not believe anything could possibly be your fault if you were not even conscious to be at fault for it.
: But what if I was’en then just...conked out? That’s why I’ve gotta talk to Sir.
: But damn if I ain’t gonna be scarlet bringin' that up to’im.
: You...wouldn’t happen ta know where he ran off to, would’ya?
: Somewhere else.
: I asked him to leave this place at once.
: But he did not seem to be himself when he agreed, so it is possible he may have ignored that command entirely.
: Ahh, shite.
: It might be best to wait until another day then. Dad always said to not make important decisions while’yer on a tear.
: I did not notice any tears in your costume. Your father would be proud.
: Hah...
: No’e wouldn’t, Kendo Princess.
: No’e wouldn’t...
